The exact opposite-pair contribution has coefficient 1/(2·(1/2))+1/(2·1)=3/2 on each adjacent squared sum. The negative part is twice the square of the sum of the three variables. Expansion gives half the sum of pairwise difference squares.

Weighted Cauchy with positive weights 2W_i,2W_{i+3} and both opposite chord sums equal to two changes the coefficient to 4/3. Subtracting the same negative part yields diagonal coefficient 2/3 and cross coefficient −4/3, giving exactly −2 at the all-ones vector.
The sign change is for the specified replacement and agrees with 3b0f32e0ae75b4d0 §4.
